top_signals.title: US Air Force seeks ‘rapidly deployable’ drone swarms for base security
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Air Force is looking to use "rapidly deployable" swarms of AI-controlled drones for base security.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Carney Woos Investors With Data Centers, Mines and LNG Deals
top_signals.summary: Canada plans to show some of the world’s biggest investors a pitchbook laying out tens of billions of dollars’ worth of projects spanning data centers, advanced manufacturing, liquefied natural gas, ports and dozens of mines.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: AI labs test the rigour of credit rating agencies
top_signals.summary: AI labs have huge private market valuations, but are seeking the investment-grade score of public groups such as Oracle
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: U.S. Treasury chief Bessent backs using U.S. financial power as foreign policy tool
top_signals.summary: The goal, he said, would be to advance the interests of American allies, including in financial and political situations abroad.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
